label: halloweenfive10
title_zh: 黄色补丁（天堂在我手中）

lines.en: label halloweenfive10:
scene yumiisheretoowtf1
: Come on, come on, come on! Pick up, you stupid fucking whore!
lines.zh: : 快点，快点，快点！接啊，你这该死的蠢婊子！

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf2
: Yumi? Hey. What’s up? I thought you were trying to stay out of-
lines.zh: : Yumi？嘿。怎么了？我还以为你要躲着——

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf3
: Yeah, cool! Whatever! What fucking day is it right now?
lines.zh: : 好，酷！随便啦！现在是他妈的几号？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Sorry, but I ain’t got time to fuck around! Or...maybe I do? Either way, just tell me what god damn day it is, Chika!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我可没时间瞎扯！或者……也许我有？不管怎样，告诉我今天是几号，Chika！

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf4
: I mean, I was trying not to bring attention to the fact that it’s your birthday because you always hate it when I do that. But if you really want me to sing for you, I will.
lines.zh: : 我是在尽量不提醒你今天是你生日，因为你每次都讨厌我那样做。不过如果你真想听我唱，我就唱。

lines.en: : Okay. So it’s still Halloween. But where the fuck are you?
lines.zh: : 好。所以还是万圣节。可你他妈在哪儿？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf5
: I’m still at the cafe for the stand-up comedy thing. We were all about to head to the hotel, but some stuff went down and now we’re all kind of just awkwardly waiting around.
lines.zh: : 我还在咖啡厅，脱口秀那个活动。我们本来都要去酒店了，结果出了点事，现在大家都在尴尬地干等着。

lines.en: : Why, though? You having second thoughts? Want to come hang out after all?
lines.zh: : 不过怎么了？你改变主意了？还是想出来玩？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf6
: What stand-up comedy thing? The fuck are you talkin’ about?
lines.zh: : 什么脱口秀？你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: : For the Dorm Wars. Tsuneyo kind of wiped the floor with Ayane, so we basically all need to win tomorrow if we’re going to come in first.
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争的啊。Tsuneyo 把 Ayane 打得落花流水，所以我们基本明天都得赢才能拿第一。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf7
: The Dorm Wars?...
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争？……

lines.en: : Yumi, is everything okay? You sound kinda weird.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你还好吗？你听着有点怪。

lines.en: : What are you dressed as this year?
lines.zh: : 你今年扮的什么？

lines.en: : I think you called it a...sex dog. But I’m a wolf-girl. That’s what the costume was labeled as at least. Have you seriously already forgotten? What the hell’s going on with you?
lines.zh: : 我觉得你管它叫……色情狗。不过我是狼女。至少服装标签上是这么写的。你真的已经忘了吗？你到底怎么了？

lines.en: : I’ve got no fucking clue...
lines.zh: : 我他妈一点头绪都没有……

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf5
: It’s gonna sound fuckin’ crazy, but like...I think I just jumped like two years into the past.
lines.zh: : 听起来会很扯，不过……我觉得我刚跳回了大概两年前。

lines.en: : Neat. Do Sensei and I ever get together in the future or is he still fucking his niece?
lines.zh: : 酷。那我和 Sensei 在未来有没有在一起，还是他还在操他侄女？

lines.en: : What? No, I don’t give a shit about that. Just...is Makoto there?
lines.zh: : 什么？不，那种破事我才不在乎。只是……Makoto 在吗？

lines.en: : Makoto? What do you want Makoto for? I thought you hated her?
lines.zh: : Makoto？你找 Makoto 干嘛？我以为你讨厌她？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf8
: I don’t hate her. She’s just fuckin’...different from me, okay? But can you make her stick around, please? I need to talk to her about somethin’ before I blow my fuckin’ brains out.
lines.zh: : 我不讨厌她。她只是他妈的……跟我不一样，行吧？不过你能不能让她别走？我得跟她谈点事，不然我他妈要一枪崩了自己。

lines.en: : Why don’t you just meet us at the hotel instead? It’s the same one where we always hang out on holidays. You remember how to get there, right?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不来酒店找我们？就是节假日我们常去的那家。你还记得怎么走吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, I remember...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我记得……

lines.en: : And, like...just out of curiosity, shit just...feels totally normal to you?
lines.zh: : 还有，就是……纯好奇，这一切对你来说就……完全正常？

lines.en: : I don’t think any of us feel “normal” after what we just witnessed, but I’m not sure what you mean apart from that- which you weren’t even here for.
lines.zh: : 我想我们刚看完那场之后没人会觉得「正常」，不过除此之外我不懂你什么意思——而且你当时根本不在场。

lines.en: : So you don’t remember gettin’ into a fight with me over allegedly cozying up to your creeper “boyfriend?”
lines.zh: : 所以你不记得我们为了你跟你那个变态「男朋友」贴太近而吵过架？

lines.en: : I have a boyfriend? Since when?
lines.zh: : 我有男朋友？什么时候的事？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf9
: Where the fuck am I?...
lines.zh: : 我他妈到底在哪儿？……

lines.en: : That’s what I want to know! You’re being super sketchy, so I’ll just call you a taxi and you can meet us at the hotel. Okay? Now, tell me more about this boyfriend you dreamt up. Is he hot? What grade is he in?
lines.zh: : 这正是我想知道的！你太可疑了，我这就给你叫辆出租车，你来酒店找我们。好吗？现在，多跟我说说你梦出来的这个男朋友。他帅吗？几年级？

lines.en: scene black
: Don’t worry about it. Just...make sure Four-Eyes knows I’m comin’, okay? And definitely don’t try to get a boyfriend any time soon. You’re a fucking psychotic mess when you have one.
lines.zh: : 别管了。就……务必让四眼知道我要来，好吗？还有，近期千万别交男朋友。你有男朋友的时候就是个疯子。

lines.en: : Why do you have such a weird version of me inside your head?! I’d be a great girlfriend! You just don’t understand because you’re immune to love.
lines.zh: : 你脑子里怎么会有这么奇怪的一版我？！我会是个超棒的女朋友！你不懂，因为你对爱免疫。

lines.en: : Yeah, cool. Bye.
lines.zh: : 是啊，酷。再见。

lines.en: : Yumi, wait-
lines.zh: : Yumi，等等——

lines.en: : Is this...how this shit always works?...
lines.zh: : 这……这破事一直是这么运作的吗？……

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf10
No!
lines.zh: 不是！

lines.en: No, it wasn’t. But of course Yumi didn’t know that because this was her first foray into what it’s really like living in Kumon-mi. And boy what a foray it would be!
lines.zh: 不，不是的。当然 Yumi 不知道这些，因为这是她第一次真正体验住在 Kumon-mi 是什么感觉。而这体验可真够可以的！

lines.en: Fortunately though, there was no shortage of people in different places experiencing the same thing to share her confusion with! Unfortunately, however, most of them happened to be in different places in time.
lines.zh: 不过幸运的是，在不同地方经历着同样事情的人并不少，可以和她分享这份困惑！不幸的是，他们大多身处不同的时间点。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf11
Like these two! Or at least one of these two! Kind of.
lines.zh: 比如这两个！或者至少是这两个中的一个！算是吧。

lines.en: Maya Makinami knew that something was wrong-ish, but she couldn’t put her finger on what as the lingering memory of a fight from earlier this morning overwrote everything else she was feeling.
lines.zh: Maya Makinami 知道有什么地方不太对劲，但她说不上来是什么——因为今天早上那场争吵的残留记忆压过了她其他所有感受。

lines.en: Or almost everything at least! Because these are really just guesses and I can’t actually peer into her head! But if I could, I imagine she’d be thinking of Ami as well.
lines.zh: 或者至少几乎压过了所有！因为这些真的只是猜测，我并不能真的窥视她的脑子！但如果能，我想她大概也在想 Ami。

lines.en: Probably something like, “Wow, her legs are soft.” Or, “Wow! She smells so nice!” Or, “Wow, I hope she tears off my costume and throws me onto the floor and finger-fucks me until I piss myself!”
lines.zh: 大概是那种，「哇，她的腿好软。」或者，「哇！她闻起来好香！」或者，「哇，真希望她扯掉我的服装把我扔到地上，用手指操我到我自己尿出来！」

lines.en: You know. Normal things that normal people think. And Maya Makinami is a NORMAL TEENAGE GIRL after all.
lines.zh: 你懂的。正常人想的正常事。而 Maya Makinami 毕竟是个正常的青春期少女。

lines.en: And what better time to experiment than when you’re alone and curious and horny and sad and traveling through time?!
lines.zh: 而当你又孤独又好奇、又饥渴又难过、还在穿越时间的时候，还有什么比这更适合做实验的时机呢？！

lines.en: NOW KISS.
lines.zh: 现在，亲。

lines.en: : So...Maya. Is there anything you need? Anything I can get you? A drink? Maybe a nice scalp massage or something?
lines.zh: : 那个……Maya。你有什么需要吗？有什么我能给你的？喝的吗？或者来个舒服的头皮按摩什么的？

lines.en: : No, I’m fine...I think I just need to rest a little. It was kind of loud in there and...I’m feeling kind of disoriented. Like I’m not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 不用，我没事……我想我只是需要休息一下。里面太吵了，而且……我觉得有点晕。好像我不该在这儿似的。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf12
: Where else would you be? I’d feel super lonely if you just left me here on my own. You and I are supposed to stick together, remember?
lines.zh: : 那你该在哪儿？你要是把我一个人扔在这儿，我会超级孤独的。我们说好要黏在一起的，记得吗？

lines.en: : I don’t mean it like I’m literally considering leaving. I’m just kind of...derealizing, I guess? Do you know what that means?
lines.zh: : 我不是字面意义上想走。我只是……有点现实解体，大概？你知道那是什么意思吗？

lines.en: : No, I’m dumb.
lines.zh: : 不知道，我很笨。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf13
: Well, since you’re so dumb, allow me to explain.
lines.zh: : 好吧，既然你这么笨，那就让我来解释。

lines.en: : I basically just mean that this feels more like a movie than real life. And that any minute now, I’m going to wake up in our dorm room and hear you moaning Sensei’s name in your sleep.
lines.zh: : 我基本就是觉得，这感觉更像电影而不是现实生活。而且随时我都会在我们的宿舍房间里醒来，听见你梦里呻吟着 Sensei 的名字。

lines.en: : Do I actually do that?
lines.zh: : 我真的会那样吗？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf14
: Mhm. Or at least I’m going to pretend you’re doing it in your sleep since the alternative is way too kinky for a girl as cute as you.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。或者至少我会假装你是在梦里做的，因为另一种可能对像你这么可爱的女孩来说太变态了。

lines.en: : I...normally wait until you’re not in the room to do that kind of stuff...
lines.zh: : 我……一般会等你不在房间的时候才做那种事……

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf15
: Normally?
lines.zh: : 一般？

lines.en: : I’m sure there...have been exceptions...
lines.zh: : 我相信……也有过例外……

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf16
: Th-That’s not what we’re here to talk about, though! You’re supposed to be getting rest! That’s the whole reason we snuck away, isn’t it? So if you’re telling me you’re already feeling better-
lines.zh: : 不、不过我们不是来聊这个的！你应该休息！我们偷偷溜出来就是为了这个，不是吗？所以如果你跟我说你已经好多了——

lines.en: : A few more minutes won’t hurt, will it? We’ve barely spent any time alone together lately.
lines.zh: : 再待几分钟也没关系吧？我们最近几乎没怎么单独待在一起。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf17
: Is that your way of telling me you miss me?
lines.zh: : 你这是在告诉我你想我了吗？

lines.en: : Better. It’s me telling you I love you.
lines.zh: : 更好。我是在告诉你我爱你。

lines.en: : And how I can’t wait for our threesome.
lines.zh: : 还有我有多等不及我们的三人行。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf18
: For our what?
lines.zh: : 我们的什么？

lines.en: : Wait...isn’t that what we were talking about earlier when-
lines.zh: : 等等……我们刚才不是在说这个吗，当——

lines.en: : Oh...sorry. I didn’t realize you two were in here.
lines.zh: : 哦……抱歉。我不知道你们俩在这儿。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf19
: Oh! H-Hey, Molly! You didn’t just...hear something super weird and random, right?
lines.zh: : 哦！嘿、嘿，Molly！你没……刚好听到什么奇怪又随机的东西，对吧？

lines.en: : No, I’m just...I don’t feel so great. Seeing Nithhala with that succubus is like...a dagger in my heart and I...I don’t want to deal with that right now...
lines.zh: : 没有，我只是……我不太舒服。看着 Nithhala 和那个魅魔在一起就像……一把匕首插在我心上，而我……我现在不想面对那个……

lines.en: : So I was hoping I could find reprieve in here for a moment or two, but...I don’t want to interrupt.
lines.zh: : 所以我本来想在这里找片刻的喘息，不过……我不想打扰你们。

lines.en: : You actually might have saved my life by arriving when you-
lines.zh: : 你来得还真是救了我的命——

lines.en: : Oh! I have an idea! Why not raid Ayane’s kitchen? Maya and I are kind of talking right now anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦！我有个主意！不如去扫荡 Ayane 的厨房？反正我和 Maya 现在也算在聊天。

lines.en: : Nevermind, I guess. Ami clearly wants to kill me.
lines.zh: : 算了，当我没说。Ami 显然想杀了我。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Arborea...I’m not feeling very peckish right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Arborea……我现在没什么胃口。

lines.en: : She has other stuff too, you know! Like beer and wine and all sorts of stuff you can use to numb the pain of your unrequited love!
lines.zh: : 她那儿还有别的东西呢，你知道的！比如啤酒、葡萄酒，还有各种各样的东西能让你麻痹单恋的痛苦！

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf20
: I...don’t know about that. The last time I got drunk at a Halloween party didn’t exactly...end well for me.
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定。上次我在万圣节派对上喝醉，结果对我来说可不太……美妙。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you’ve got like a million extra people to watch over you this time. I’m sure you’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过这次你身边多了大概一百万人看着你呢。我肯定你没事的。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf21
: Well, I...I suppose that does sound better than simply...watching the two of them or roaming Amamiyoria for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我……我想那总比单纯……看着她们俩，或者在 Amamiyoria 里游荡到永恒要好。

lines.en: : Amamiyoria?
lines.zh: : Amamiyoria？

lines.en: : The realm of the Amamiyas, duh.
lines.zh: : Amamiya 家的领地啊，笨。

lines.en: : I...suppose I’ll be off then.
lines.zh: : 我……想我还是走吧。

lines.en: : If you want to just wait a few minutes-
lines.zh: : 你要是愿意就等几分钟——

lines.en: : Bye, Molly! See you later! Don’t drink too much! Just enough to become fun. Or find a secret room and cope with your unrequited love in the more carnal and physical way! Just be sure to lock the door.
lines.zh: : 拜拜，Molly！回头见！别喝太多！刚好够变得有趣就行。或者找个秘密房间，用更肉欲、更物理的方式应对你的单恋！记得锁门就好。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf22
: Did you just...tell our friend to go masturbate her sadness away?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚……是叫我们的朋友去自慰来赶走悲伤吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps I’ll just do both? Who knows where this night will take me?
lines.zh: : 也许我两样都做？谁知道今晚会发生什么。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf23
: Farewell, Mona. Farewell, Amber. Let the promise of ale whisk me away to...ahh, fuck it. Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 永别了，Mona。永别了，Amber。让麦酒的承诺带我远走高飞，去……啊，去他妈的。晚安。

lines.en: : So what’s this about a threesome?
lines.zh: : 那么这个三人行是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf24
: Do you seriously not remember that?! It was your idea! And you were really fucking into it!
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得了？！那是你的主意！而且你还他妈的超级来劲！

lines.en: : I think I’d remember suggesting a threesome to my best friend! This is a super weird way to confess that you’re into Sensei, Maya! What the heck?!
lines.zh: : 我要是向我最好的朋友提议三人行，我肯定会记得的！Maya，这是你坦白喜欢上 Sensei 的超级奇怪的方式啊！什么鬼？！

lines.en: : I didn’t confess anything! You’re the one who figured it out when I got really upset about Niki moving in!
lines.zh: : 我什么都没坦白！是你自己发现的——当时 Niki 搬进来让我非常难过！

lines.en: : With who?!
lines.zh: : 和谁？！

lines.en: : You!
lines.zh: : 你啊！

lines.en: : Since when?! And why am I only hearing about this now?!
lines.zh: : 从什么时候开始的？！为什么我现在才听说？！

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf25
: Since when?...
lines.zh: : 从什么时候开始？……

lines.en: : Maybe I...really am inside of a dream or a...movie right now. Because there’s no way I just...thought all that stuff up, did I?
lines.zh: : 也许我……现在真的在一个梦里，或者一部……电影里。因为我不可能只是……凭空想出那些东西，对吧？

lines.en: : So you...really like Sensei then?
lines.zh: : 所以你……真的喜欢 Sensei 了？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf26
: Huh?...No, I...
: I mean yes, I...
lines.zh: : 我意思是是的，我……

lines.en: : I don’t...I don’t really know...
lines.zh: : 我……我不太确定……

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf27
: Sorry, I...I thought you knew.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我……我以为你知道。

lines.en: : There was a...or at least I thought there was a whole thing earlier about...how that made you feel and...what we were going to do about it now that he was choosing Niki over us...
lines.zh: : 之前有个……或者至少我以为有个完整的事，关于……那让你有什么感受，以及……既然他选了 Niki 而不是我们，我们要怎么办……

lines.en: : I...didn’t even realize those two had gotten close again.
lines.zh: : 我……甚至都没意识到她们俩又变得那么亲近了。

lines.en: : This is...really bad news, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这……真是个坏消息，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...which is why we were going to do the threesome thing, I think. You said something about “dragging him back to us.”
lines.zh: : 是啊……所以我想我们才要搞那个三人行。你说了什么「把他拽回我们身边」之类的。

lines.en: : Maya, I’m sorry but this had to have been a dream or something. There’s no way I’d resort to such a ridiculous tactic to win Sensei over when I already know he’d choose me over her if I just ask.
lines.zh: : Maya，抱歉，可那一定是个梦之类的。我不可能用这么荒唐的手段去赢回 Sensei——我明明知道只要我开口，他就会选我而不是她。

lines.en: : But that’s...that’s something I’d have to deal with on my own.
lines.zh: : 但那是……那是我得自己面对的事。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf28

: B-Besides! It’s possible that, like...you’re totally just making this up right now! Hahahah! You are feeling pretty out of it, aren’t you? Like...you didn’t even know who you were dressed as a little while ago!
lines.zh: : 再、再说！很可能，就是……你现在完全是编出来的！哈哈哈！你现在脑子确实不太清楚，不是吗？比如……你刚才连自己扮的是谁都不知道！

lines.en: : Yeah...something’s clearly wrong with me. I just...have no idea what.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我明显哪里不对劲。只是……我不知道是什么。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf29
: Everything seems so...familiar but...also so fucking foreign at the same time that it’s kind of like I’m just floating through a sea of nothingness right now.
lines.zh: : 一切看起来都那么……熟悉，可同时又他妈那么陌生，以至于我现在就像漂浮在一片虚无之海上。

lines.en: : And if you weren’t here to be my anchor, I...I feel like I might just drift away or...something corny like that...
lines.zh: : 而要不是你在这儿当我的锚，我……我觉得我可能就这么漂走了，或者……诸如此类烂俗的话……

lines.en: : Well, uh...
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……

lines.en: : Um...how can I put this gently?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我该怎么委婉地说呢？

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf30
: I kinda...
lines.zh: : 我有点……
: ……Ami？

lines.en: : I kinda, like...need a minute to process all of this. So I think I’m gonna like...go for a walk or something.
lines.zh: : 我有点，就是……需要一分钟消化这些。所以我想我大概……去走走什么的。

lines.en: : I...I really wasn’t trying to upset you if that’s what-
lines.zh: : 我……我真的不是想让你难过，如果那——

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf31
: No, no, no! It’s fine! I’m...used to finding out how my friends feel about him with...Ayane being so...forward about it every single day. I just...I need a minute, okay?
lines.zh: : 不不不！没事！我……已经习惯了发现我的朋友对他有那种感觉——毕竟 Ayane 每天都那么……直白。我只是……需要一分钟，好吗？

lines.en: : But I...I really don’t want to be alone right now...
lines.zh: : 可是我……我现在真的不想一个人……

lines.en: : Then, uhh...oh! Okay! How about I just...get a head start then...you count to ten and chase after me?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……哦！好吧！不如我先跑，然后……你数到十再来追我？

lines.en: : Like...hide and seek?
lines.zh: : 像……捉迷藏？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah! Just like hide and seek! And Ayane’s mansion is full of hiding places, so I can just...cram myself into one of those and figure out how to deal with all of this while you look for me.
lines.zh: : 对、对！就像捉迷藏！Ayane 的豪宅到处都是藏身的地方，我可以……挤进其中一个，一边等你找我，一边想办法消化这一切。

lines.en: : You really won’t stay and talk any longer?...
lines.zh: : 你真的不愿意多留一会儿聊聊吗？……

lines.en: : Maya, I...
lines.zh: : Maya，我……

lines.en: : Please...
lines.zh: : 求你了……

lines.en: scene black
: You can start counting once the door closes...
lines.zh: : 门关上之后你就可以开始数了……

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf32
: Ten.
Paper doors and lanterns — arms that stretch for miles wide.
lines.zh: 纸门与灯笼——伸展开绵延数英里的手臂。

lines.en: : Nine.
Ice cream cones and sunburn — not knowing when to laugh or cry.
lines.zh: 冰淇淋甜筒与晒伤——不知道该笑还是该哭。

lines.en: : Eight.
Hide and seek and coloring — in books with pages white as snow.
lines.zh: 捉迷藏与涂色——在白如雪的书页里。

lines.en: : Seven...
Senseless, violent muttering — not knowing when you shouldn’t know.
lines.zh: 无意义而暴力的呢喃——不知道何时你本不该知道。

lines.en: : Six.
Watermelons left in light — a yellow patch to prove their worth.
lines.zh: 留在光下的西瓜——一块黄色补丁证明它们的价值。

lines.en: : Five.
My mommy is a puzzle now — we dumped her pieces in the dirt.
lines.zh: 我妈妈现在成了一道谜题——我们把她的碎片倒进了土里。

lines.en: : Four.
No one has it worse than me — and no one ever understands.
lines.zh: 没有人比我更惨——而没有人能理解。

lines.en: : Three...
An angel put a curse on me — now there’s Heaven in my hands.
lines.zh: 一个天使对我下了诅咒——于是我手里有了天堂。

lines.en: scene yumiisheretoowtf33
: Two...
A box of better days — a room that’s filled with scary things.
lines.zh: 一盒更好的日子——一个装满可怕东西的房间。

lines.en: scene black
: One.
A poem for you from me — a lonely girl with broken wings.
lines.zh: 一首我给你的诗——来自一个断翅的孤独女孩。
